environment: isolated synthetic SQLite preview; headless Chrome CDP touch emulation, 390×844, prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

Existing synthetic checks cover 0/1/2/30 card counts, arrow/dot/keyboard selection, per-space remembered selection and removed/foreign card fallback.
